page.layout: One printed page. Running text in one column on the right, with marginal notes in the left margin. The page number and running head sit at the top.

main_text.l: quarum prima Exordium constat: aut si-
ne τῆς εὐχαριστίας[?]. lib.10. epist.11. lib.13. epist.
ἀξίωσιν[?] petitionem habet, ut quod iam fe-
cit amicus; deinceps quoque facere mi-
tam, vel à caufis.lib.3.epist.5. vel effectis.

page.notes: Right-hand edge of the page is cut off; the final word of the last line is cut short, so "polli-" is the printed fragment. The Greek words (ἐυχαριστικῶν, τῆς εὐχαριστίας, εὐχαριστίαν, ἀξίωσιν) and the Greek at the end of the last line are uncertain and marked [?]. The final Greek word after "aut" is not legible enough to transcribe and is left as [?]. The marginal notes "Conclusiones" (at the foot of the left margin) and "Propositiones" were read from the small italic type in the margin; the spacing of the note "Confirmatio-nes" is uncertain. The reading "ftrema" at the start of the last line is "strema" with long s printed as a plain s, from "postrema".
